build_VGG_model: build a VGG11/13/16/19 PyTorch model for CIFAR-10 image classification with 10 output classes
run_VGG_forward: run a forward pass through a VGG model on a batch of 32x32 RGB images
create_VGG_features: create the convolutional feature extraction layers from a VGG config with Conv2d, BatchNorm2d, and ReLU
test_VGG_inference: test a VGG model by passing a random tensor of shape (batch, 3, 32, 32) through it
review_VGG_make_layers: review the VGG _make_layers method that builds sequential Conv2d, BatchNorm2d, ReLU, and pooling layers from a config list
